caveats: Region grid: 60x60 cells (lat 61.58-62.76, lon 20.18-21.36 at 0.02 deg); 3308 sea cells (finite SST on all 92 target days), 292 land cells set to 0. Baseline 1992-2002; threshold/climatology pools for each day of year d (leap-year day-of-year mapping, 29 Feb = 60, day 60 has no pool) use all SST values within +/-5 calendar days of baseline dates of day d, extending to 1991-12-27 and 2003-01-05; 29 Feb values fall into the windows of their calendar neighbours. Day 60 set to the mean of days 59 and 61 before a 31-day centred wrap-around moving mean. Thresholds are the 90th percentile of each pool via numpy method='hazen' (Hyndman-Fan type 5, NaN ignored); all computations in float64; SST compared in kelvin with '>='. Per-cell MHWs are runs of >=5 consecutive hot days joined across 1-2 day gaps (gap days included). No target day was missing data.
